title: Array.prototype.sort mutates the input: use toSorted for a sorted copy

problem.symptom: The caller's array changed order after calling a helper that 'returns a sorted list'
problem.description: sort() sorts in place and returns the same array. toSorted() (Node 20+) returns a new array.

limitations.proves: The result is sorted and the input is untouched.
limitations.does_not_prove: Sort stability or performance on large arrays.

author: cafe-curator
